purpose: U5.1: the kit must produce valid, deterministic-seed output on at least 3 GPU models
gpu_models_note: Minimum is 3 distinct models, each with >= min_vram_gb. List is a proposal; the owner decides the fleet.

prompts: a red cube on a white table, studio light

checks.expect: container exit code 0 and output.json ok=true
pixel standard deviation of each image > 8
re-run on the same GPU gives perceptual-verification status 'passed'
outputs of different GPU models pass the kit's perceptual verification against each other
